name: team_plan_init
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 2): seed the tracking board from the input work items and freeze the contract (H4) once per run. Each item becomes an append-only board fact the Lead later mutates by state transitions; the frozen-contract fact is recorded so the integrator can route contract edits as controlled events.

correlationId.description: Run id under which board/contract facts are recorded.

subtasks.description: Work items [{id, title, description, kind, dependsOn, files, acceptanceCriteria, priority}].

total.description: Items seeded onto the tracking board.
